dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I love these kinds of streets! They're always super lively and beautiful.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I especially love climbing onto the roof and looking down at the crowd going about their day. It's incredibly fascinating to me!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Actually, while you're here, why don't you also give it a try?
